card.name: Contact lens warnings in eye drop labels
card.fires_on: Small words and symbols such as 'to', 'in', 'if' or '-related' inside contact lens wear warnings in eye product labels. A few hits are on digits in addresses or codes.

modes.label: Contact lens warning wording
modes.description: Linking words inside the sentence about not using the product for contact lens irritation or about the preservative.
modes.example: Contact Lens Wear: LASTACAFT ® should not be used<< to>> treat contact lens-related irritation.

modes.label: Digits and hyphens in codes
modes.description: Digits in zip codes or regulation numbers, and a hyphen before 'free'.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in the contact lens wear warnings of eye drop labels.
